scope: Static source review and local metadata reads only; publisher, audit and API requests were not executed. No application acceptance claim.

necessary_fixes.finding: The script reads gates.application_commit and expected source hash from local files without pinning the exact requested application commit and source digest. Internally coherent substituted receipt files can pass these guards.
necessary_fixes.recommendation: Require application_commit equal the full reviewed 7e4769922ad8055b8c290f7625401d8a42fd183b SHA and expected_source.sha256 equal 578029f5d9a608e62b1336889b52e90025831732aeec2cea087a1dd8d57d7ee2; require the actual full gate receipts to bind that candidate and explicitly pass scoped acceptance.

necessary_fixes.finding: The initial candidate/source/clean checks precede a long audit. HEAD is captured after audit without verifying audit.head, current source or immutable gate bytes still match. Candidate-change detection currently follows GitHub object writes and branch update.
necessary_fixes.recommendation: Capture the planned exact evidence HEAD and gate/manifest file digests before audit. After audit, and immediately before the ref mutation, verify same HEAD, branch, clean tracked state, current source and unchanged gate/manifest bytes; verify fresh audit.head/branch and all tracked audit file hashes. Reverify destination private/write permission immediately before first object writes.

remaining_prerequisites.meaning: The prepared publisher currently fails closed before API writes; actual consolidated gate binding has not yet been inspected.

history_notes: Exact tree and commit SHA checks bind names, modes, all parent SHAs, authors, dates and messages; unsupported headers/timezones abort instead of rewriting history.
All local refs must be ancestors of HEAD. The importer walks complete HEAD ancestry in topological order and verifies old baseline/probe commit availability after ref publication.

No main/default-branch settings write is present; existing branch update uses force:false and an ancestor check. Cached SHA-verified immutable Git objects are reused, while the secret audit itself is fresh each invocation.

binding_note: This initial guard finding binds the original script read and hashed before root applied corrections. Its earlier evidence-write step reread the script after root had changed it; the binding was corrected here to the actual reviewed original bytes.
